cases.get.title: Intermittent Teams sign-in failures for about 140 branch users (Pune and Leeds)

resolution.summary: A DNS security policy update on one of two branch DNS resolvers blocked a CDN host used by the Teams sign-in page, causing intermittent sign-in failures for users who were served by that resolver.
resolution.rootCause: A DNS security policy update deployed to resolver 10.20.1.11 at 08:42 UTC on 2026-03-09 set the URL category 'CDN and content delivery' to block, so aadcdn.msftauth.net failed to resolve on that resolver. Clients alternate between two resolvers, which made sign-in intermittent.
resolution.workaround: Resolver 10.20.1.11 removed from the Pune and Leeds DHCP scopes on 2026-03-11 at 12:40 UTC.
resolution.permanentFix: DNS exception for Microsoft 365 endpoints deployed on 2026-03-12 at 08:50 UTC and DNS policy changes placed under change control.

validation.method: 200 consecutive Resolve-DnsName queries per resolver from both sites plus 20 hours of client sign-in telemetry (0 failures) and customer confirmation.
